Entities.Name: produtos
Entities.Query: SELECT entity_key, occurred_at_utc, payload_json, trace_id FROM sync_export.produtos WHERE occurred_at_utc > @watermark_utc ORDER BY occurred_at_utc, entity_key LIMIT @limit

Entities.Name: clientes
Entities.Query: SELECT entity_key, occurred_at_utc, payload_json, trace_id FROM sync_export.clientes WHERE occurred_at_utc > @watermark_utc ORDER BY occurred_at_utc, entity_key LIMIT @limit
